title: Vietnamese Caramel Pork
description: Thit kho. Pork belly simmered in a caramel taken right to the edge of burnt, with fish sauce and coconut water. Dark, salty, and sweet in that order.
notes: The caramel should smell almost scorched before the liquid goes in. Pale caramel makes a sweet, flat dish.

steps.text: Melt the sugar in a dry heavy pot and let it go to a deep mahogany caramel without stirring.
steps.tip: Swirl the pan rather than stirring. Take it one shade darker than looks wise.

steps.text: Add the garlic and shallots to the caramel — it will seize and spit — and stir until fragrant.
Add the pork belly and turn it until every piece is coated and starting to colour.
Pour in the coconut water and fish sauce, add the cracked black pepper, and bring to a simmer.
Cook covered on a low heat until the pork is tender.
Add the hard boiled eggs and cook uncovered so the sauce reduces to a glaze and the eggs stain brown.
